MS-50G+, built with reference to the following MIT-licensed works. Their
notices are reproduced here as those licences require.

     Modeler capture)

The tone stack's filter formulas are those of the Audio EQ Cookbook by
Robert Bristow-Johnson, credited here as their source.

The DSP kernel and the effect container were written from scratch by Thomas
Hammer (Waveformer) and contain no code from Zoom Corporation and no code from
NeuralAmpModelerCore, AudioDSPTools or NeuralAmpModelerPlugin. A capture
loaded into this effect is the work of whoever made it and carries its own
licence. This is an independent, unofficial DIY effect: not affiliated with,
endorsed by, or supported by Zoom Corporation, by Steven Atkinson or by the
Neural Amp Modeler project.
